verdict.rationale: Klaviyo is an AI-powered marketing platform (K:AI, Composer, Customer Agent) that processes customer data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an AI-training opt-out, a data-usage policy, or a related control. API key scopes limit third-party access, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit for this story.
